A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable 30-page versions of the same XTF paper. Their main text, equations, seven tables, twelve figures and Appendices A–F support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original LLM fine-tuning experiments, attribute and threshold ablations, computational measurements and token-filtering examples in Section 4 and the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experiments and analyses, including benchmark results in Tables 1 and 4, ablations and computational measurements.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same attention-based reasoning importance, prediction-probability knowledge novelty, embedding-based task relevance, filtering thresholds, union of selected tokens and masked training loss.

E1.justification: Both use GSM8K, CodeExercise with HumanEval evaluation, and PubMedQA. NuminaMath-CoT with MATH-500 evaluation and FIQA are already present in v1 Appendix C.1 and remain in v3.

E2.justification: Tables 1 and 4 retain CA, Normal, doubled epochs, DF, DA, SLM and TC. Figure 5 retains the CA, Normal and XTF code comparison. The baseline adaptations in Appendix B.2 are unchanged.

E3.justification: The model and LoRA configurations, validation-based checkpoint selection, judge-based accuracy evaluation, pass@1/5/10 metrics and Table 3 sample counts, learning rates and training epochs are unchanged.

E4.justification: Both retain attribute-combination ablations in Table 2, complementarity analysis in Figure 4, threshold sensitivity in Figure 6 and Table 5, score distributions and the token-filtering examples in Figures 8–12.

E5.justification: Both retain point estimates and averages across model configurations without reporting experimental seed counts, repeated-run counts, confidence intervals or significance tests. No uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: The benchmark, ablation and computational results match throughout. For example, Table 1 retains XTF/Normal average accuracies of 45.7/37.1 for math and 37.1/30.4 for medicine. Appendix results and plotted findings are also unchanged.

T1.justification: The method equations and Appendix A's assumptions, definitions, alignment theorems, bounds and proofs are unchanged. Appendix B.1 retains the same Otsu and Multi-Otsu formulation.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions and conclusion retain the same token-level optimization problem, three-attribute XTF contribution and performance-improvement claims, including the maximum 13.7% improvement.

C2.justification: Interpretations of attribute complementarity and model/task dependence remain unchanged, as do computational-cost limitations and theoretical caveats. Appendix F's qualification about imperfect scoring and conservative thresholds is relocated, not added.

D1.justification: Appendix B retains the same baseline implementation details, hyperparameters, bfloat16 setting, generation defaults and GPU hardware. Appendix D's implementation and resource information is unchanged, with no change to code or data access information.

R1.justification: The reference list and positioning relative to distillation, pretraining, explainability and preference training are unchanged. Citation-format revisions do not add or remove cited research.

P1.justification: v3 updates affiliations, removes the contribution and correspondence footnote, adds funding acknowledgements and standardizes parenthetical citations. Other wording edits are minimal, and the scientific narrative and section organization remain intact.

P2.justification: The existing figures and tables retain their content, captions and designs but undergo limited relocation and page reflow. Figure 1 moves from page 3 to 2, Figure 6 from page 21 to 22, and Table 7 from page 23 to 24.

improvement.justification: v3 adds funding disclosure and modest citation cleanup, alongside affiliation updates and layout reflow. These are limited editorial refinements: the scientific explanation, evidence, theory, reproducibility information and limitations remain unchanged, leaving overall paper quality essentially the same.
